_doc: One-time contextual tips. Each tip is shown once, the first time its trigger happens, never while the tutorial is running, and only if tips are on (Settings). on.event: an event type from the simulation (+ optional match: exact values, or {gte: n}); on.cond: a named check evaluated about once a second (rebirthReady, layer1Ready, bossUnlocked, speedUnlocked). action (optional): a button that opens a panel. Listed on the 'Tips seen' page. Add a tip by adding an object here (a new cond name needs one line in sim/tips.js).

tips.title: Your backpack is full
tips.text: Rolls stop while the backpack is full. Sell or fuse extras, or buy a bigger backpack in the Shop.

tips.title: A mutation!
tips.text: Mutations are bonus traits on an item. They multiply its stats, and the Refinery can re-roll or move them.

tips.title: A refiner
tips.text: Refiners sit in a production line and boost the units that pass through. Put one between a drill and a seller.

tips.title: Monsters attack in waves
tips.text: A wave comes about every minute. Turrets and equipped weapons fight on their own. Losing a wave costs a little money, never items.

tips.title: Bosses are unlocked
tips.text: Bosses are optional fights with big drops: a weapon with a unique mutation. Beat one in the Combat panel when you feel ready.

tips.title: Your first boss fight
tips.text: Bosses have special moves like shields and summons. You can leave any time; the only cost is a short cooldown.

tips.title: You can Rebirth now
tips.text: Rebirth restarts your run for permanent bonuses and a new region. You keep your level, rewards and Rebirth Points.

tips.title: Welcome to a new region
tips.text: Everything was reset except what rebirth keeps. Spend Rebirth Points in the tree for permanent upgrades.

tips.title: A new prestige layer
tips.text: Prestige layers stack: the next layer resets the one below it for a stronger kind of bonus, and layers never end.

tips.title: Faster game speed
tips.text: You unlocked a faster game speed. Pick it in Settings. It only speeds up the game, never your saves or offline progress.
